facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: unplanned release of pressure energy at CY-3212

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 1 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control STORED_ENERGY_DISSIPATION: the dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy was in place but did not perform, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an individual or team action.

recommendations: Confirm at the next critical control verification that the dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy on CY-3212 and PT-3212 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in verifying pressure relief and protection, specifically proving overpressure protection is in service. CY-3212 (cyclone clusters) is in service for classification duty on the grinding circuit. The task proceeded during an intrusive maintenance task while the dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy was in place but did not perform. The pressure energy involved is held as hydraulic accumulator, and the recorded presentation was jet release, stored-energy discharge, rupture.
response.summary: On 7 November 2019 a potential incident was recorded on CY-3212 and PT-3212 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during an intrusive maintenance task; pressure energy held as hydraulic accumulator was not released.
